notes.title: Main beta version Update #2
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]We have been working hard and are ready to present you with another major update to the demo version of the game[/p][p][b]What's new:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Long-eared companions added[/p][/*][*][p]Rage mode added[/p][/*][*][p]Locations redesigned[/p][/*][*][p]New enemy grenade behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]VFX update[/p][/*][*][p]New skill cards design[/p][/*][*][p]аnd many other minor changes![/p][/*][/list][p][b]In the next update (in about a week), we will show you a much more interesting boss fight and more destructibility in locations. Stay tuned[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/566c914612bef81f64c849ffee19e8960b69b4f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/31a557e3470e4cb6b8d0c9e7bcdccd1156c9e391.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/dadc906fea80d18dd330f70a8e35e03ef4574640.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Main demo version update
notes.notes: [p][b]Today we've released a major update to demo version.[/b] Here's the patchnote:[/p][list][*][p]Significantly redesigned the locations[/p][/*][*][p]Added lots of new enemies, including Priests and flying beetles[/p][/*][*][p]Added a rage mode (builds up by killing enemies)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the visuals for upgrades and many other in-game elements[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to carry two types of weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added exploding barrels[/p][/*][*][p]And much more![/p][/*][/list][p][b]We hope you enjoy this update. Please share your thoughts so we know which direction to take the project in next![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/744a5e3c0e62f9d02f72542cc9f533e97fd34de5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/0e3cf4b02d6efb9f1c488ed6a7982c47084c2272.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/74c4c600669668e921476b077b6dc2a72c8e4db9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]
